At Hayden Summer Camps, we offer a diverse range of programs designed to provide a summer filled with fun, exploration, and learning.With activities for preschoolers through middle schoolers, our camps create an engaging environment where kids can build friendships,develop new skills, and make lifelong memories. Camp Planning Chart Camp Calendar Summer Camp Registration Resident Registration: Begins February 11, 2 026 at 11:00 AM Non-Resident Registration: Begins February 18, 2026 at 11:00 AM Registration Requirements $50 deposit per camper, per week is due at the time of registration Participants must maintain an active membership for the full duration of each camp session for which they are registered Health Forms & Required Information Hayden Summer Camps will be partnering with CampDoc for the third year to help ensure accurate, up-to-date health information and to support a safe, healthy, and successful camp experience for all campers. After completing camp registration, families will receive an email from CampDoc with instructions to create a new account or log in to an existing account . Through CampDoc, parents/guardians will be required to provide: Parent/guardian contact information Emergency contact information Medical history and health details A current physical examination In accordance with Massachusetts state regulations, physical examinations are valid for 18 months from the date of the exam . All CampDoc health forms, including the physical, must be completed no later than two weeks prior to your child’s first day of camp . Campers may not attend camp unless all required health information is complete. Hayden Summer Camps reserves the right to unenroll campers whose health forms remain incomplete after this deadline. Registration Deadlines Registration for each camp week will close on the Sunday of the week before the camp session begins (for example, a June 29 start date closes on June 21). To inquire about availability after registration has closed, please email reccentre@jwhayden.org. Transfers & Cancellations Transfers Transfer requests may be submitted but are not guaranteed . All transfer requests will be reviewed by the Camp Director and approved only if space availability, staffing ratios, and enrollment levels allow. To request a transfer, families must submit a Transfer Request Form . Cancellations At least three weeks prior to the start of the camp session: A refund or account credit will be issued, minus a $50 administrative fee . Less than three weeks prior to the start of the camp session: No refunds or credits will be issued. Camp Group Assignments To create the best possible experience for every camper, registration for Traditional Day Camp is organized by age group: Lower Camp: Ages 4 to Entering Grade 1 Upper Camp: Grades 2 to 6 Our camp leadership team will create smaller weekly camper groups within each section, ensuring a safe, engaging environment while maintaining appropriate counselor-to-camper ratios. There may be multiple groups within the same age range. Making new friends is an important part of the camp experience! While we will do our best to consider group placement requests, we cannot guarantee that all requests can be accommodated. Camper groupings are thoughtfully created by our camp team to ensure a safe, supportive, and positive experience for everyone. Please note: Upper and Lower Camp groupings do not apply to Specialty Camps . Camp Programs Traditional Day Camps Our Traditional Day Camps offer a well-rounded summer experience with a mix of sports, arts, games, daily free swim,outdoor activities, and themed programming. These camps are designed to provide structure while allowing for free play,creativity, and social interaction. Lower Camp (Ages 4 to Entering Grade 1) Lower Camp combines the best of our former Tricon Minute Kids programs into one thoughtfully designed camp experience for our youngest campers. This program offers a gentle introduction to summer camp with age-appropriate activities in a nurturing, structured environment. Campers enjoy outdoor exploration, swimming, creative crafts, group games, and guided free play that supports social development, confidence, and independence. Small group experiences and consistent routines help children feel safe, supported, and excited to come to camp each day. More Information and Register Upper Camp (Grades 2 – 6) Upper Camp builds on the classic summer camp experience previously offered through Day Camp, designed for older campers ready for more variety, teamwork, and independence. Campers participate in a wide range of activities including sports, arts and crafts, outdoor games, team-building challenges, and weekly themed events. The program encourages active play, creativity, leadership, and friendship-building in a fun, engaging, and supportive setting where campers can explore new interests and make lasting memories. More Information and Register Pre-School Mini Camps Our Pre-School Mini Camps provide a fun and nurturing introduction to summer camp for our youngest participants. These camps focus on creativity, movement, and play-based learning in a safe and structured setting. Offerings vary by year but may include Little Dancers, Nugget Ninjas and Pre-School Fun. More Information and Register Specialty Camps For campers looking to dive deeper into their passions, our Specialty Camps provide unique opportunities to explore a wide range of interests. Offerings may include: Trip Camp: Supervised off-site trips that offer campers the chance to explore new places, stay active, and build friendships. Sports Camp: A mix of athletic games and skill development in various sports. Cooking Camp: Budding chefs learn kitchen skills and create delicious recipes. Dance Camp: Movement, choreography, and creative dance activities. Theater Camp: Acting, improvisation, and performance skills. Basketball Camp: Focused skill-building and gameplay for all levels. Art Camp: Exploring different artistic mediums and techniques. Our Specialty Camps change from year to year, offering fresh and exciting experiences each summer. These camps allow campers to develop new skills, build confidence, and have fun in a focused, small-group setting.
